title: Scenario-driven catalog onboarding checklist and regional gating for new models
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: This ticket coordinates a scenario-driven go-to-market checklist for adding a new model to the Redwood catalog. Purpose: reduce regressions at launch by gating the release on benchmark signoff, docs readiness, localized release notes, and regional compliance checks. Scope covers hosted catalog entry, catalog metadata, benchmark artifacts, release notes, docs updates, console feature flags, and comms to customers and partners.
checklist: Define target scenarios (chat summarization, zero-shot code assist, embeddings similarity) and acceptance thresholds
Run controlled benchmark suite vs baseline models; capture p50/p90/p99 latency, token cost, and quality metrics (ROUGE/BLEU/embedding cosine drift)
Quantitative signoff by Research: attach benchmark report and regression dashboard link
Create catalog metadata entry (display name, tags, supported endpoints, recommended context length, default quantization profile)
Draft release notes: highlights, breaking changes (if any), migration guidance, sample prompts, example SDK calls
Docs tasks: quickstart, best-practices, known-limits, troubleshooting section; link internal doc review PR
Console changes: add model to dropdowns, enable per-model telemetry, set rollout flag to 'canary'
Legal & Compliance: confirm data residency requirements and KMS support for private deployments
Localization: translate user-facing release notes and quickstart for EU and APAC locales
Prepare customer announcement list and segment by usage (heavy embedding users, low-latency customers)
Create rollback/fallback plan: default fallback model mapping and automated routing policy
Schedule post-launch evaluation window and metrics collection (72h, 14d, 30d)
Publish final catalog entry and flip rollout from canary to staged to full following metric gates

notes: 2026-03-02 - Research: Found a 6% embedding drift on long-context docs; suggested KV cache tweak (see PR #142)
2026-03-04 - Runtime: Implemented selective kernel fallback to reduce p99 latency; p99 improved from 520ms -> 380ms in canary
Decision: Localized release notes are required for FR/DE/JA for initial rollout (comms request from EMEA/APAC leads)
Trade-off: Enabling aggressive quantization reduces cost by 20% but increases hallucination risk for long-context summarization; will gate behind quality flag and explicit docs guidance
Follow-up: Schedule a cross-team retro 2 weeks post-full-rollout to capture train of fixes and doc gaps
localization_requirements: Translate quickstart and release notes to FR, DE, JA
Adapt example prompts to local idioms for EN-GB and EN-AU where relevant
Verify legal phrasing with regional counsel for data residency statements
rollout_strategy: Canary in single region with 1% traffic for 24h
Increase to 10% regional traffic for 72h if no regressions
Open staged rollout to additional regions behind explicit compliance gates
Full rollout conditional on metric gates over 72h and signoff from Research and Support
